properties.name: Észak-nyugati városrész
properties.sourcePeriod: 2016 ITS; underlying imagery marked 2015 on detailed maps
properties.method: Manual white cartographic ink tracing; pixel-step polygonization; approximate manually identified scene landmark affine registration in EOV, then EPSG:4326. Source outline preserved; nationwide placement unverified.
properties.registrationUncertainty: All scene point identifications are approximate. The detailed map-to-overview correspondence and urban-network overlay do not establish source-pixel accuracy. Spatial extent and individual edge placement require independent registration. Fit residuals are internal diagnostics, not absolute accuracy.
properties.uncertaintyAppliesTo: All geographic boundary vertices and segments through unverified registration, rather than a fabricated missing cap or street connector.
properties.license: Municipal/Google Earth imagery reuse licence unestablished; ODbL-1.0 for OSM calibration
properties.attribution: Gyöngyös municipal ITS; imagery Google Earth / DigitalGlobe 2015; © OpenStreetMap contributors
